name: botbridge-cc-helper
displayName: Bot Bridge CC Helper — MCP Task Bridge for Local Coding Agents
description: Bridge remote bots (Cursor, Copilot Chat, Grok Bot) to a local Bot Bridge CC Helper on Windows over MCP: dispatch coding tasks into its inbox and read progress back. Runs your local Claude Code. Independent product, not affiliated with Anthropic.

botbridge-cc-helper.enabled.markdownDescription: Offer the local Helper bridge as an MCP server to VS Code. When off, no MCP server is offered; the commands still work.

botbridge-cc-helper.helperHome.markdownDescription:
Folder of the local Bot Bridge CC Helper install (the one that owns `inbox\`, `running\`, `done\` and `control\`). Leave empty to use `%USERPROFILE%\cc-helper`.

_Machine scope:_ this decides which folder this extension writes job files into, so it can only be set in user settings, never per workspace — a cloned repository cannot redirect it.

botbridge-cc-helper.nodePath.markdownDescription:
Node.js executable used to launch the bundled bridge (`scripts/cc-helper-mcp.js`). Leave empty to reuse the Node runtime that ships inside VS Code.

_Machine scope:_ this decides which executable is launched, so it can only be set in user settings, never per workspace.
